title.en: An Act Establishing the Bonliw National High School in the Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing the Bonliw National High School in the Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Bonliw Quốc gia tại Đô thị Torrijos, Tỉnh Marinduque, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bonliw แห่งชาติ ในเทศบาล Torrijos จังหวัด Marinduque และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Bonliw Nasional di Kotamadya Torrijos, Provinsi Marinduque, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Bonliw Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Torrijos, Wilayah Marinduque, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, the Bonliw National High School in the Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
